name: Mendoza
about: Harvest season (Feb–Apr) is festive and scenic, summer (Dec–Feb) is hot, winter (Jun–Aug) brings snow to the nearby mountains.
overview: Malbec country at the foot of the Andes, where vineyard lunches and asado dinners are the main event.
costOverview: A tasting flight and empanadas cost a fraction of equivalent experiences in Napa or Bordeaux — genuinely one of the best-value major wine regions anywhere.

costItems.label: Wine tasting flight, Luján de Cuyo

specialSeasons.text: Grape harvest (vendimia) is underway, celebrated with a major wine festival in early March.
